g.text: ESP32 HOME AUTOMATION — SIMPLEST POWER SCHEMATICS
Minimal Component Count Options | Clean, Brownout-Free Operation | Easy to Build in EasyEDA
Uses ESP32 NodeMCU DevKit Onboard AMS1117 Regulator | Just 1 Extra Buffer Capacitor on PCB
Drops 5V to 3.3V Internally — No PCB soldering!
Zero extra regulators on your PCB!
OPTION B: MINIMAL EXTERNAL AMS1117 (JUST 3 PARTS)
For bare ESP32 modules or offloading heat from NodeMCU | Exactly 3 Components
OPTION B COMPONENT SUMMARY (EXACTLY 3 PARTS TO SOLDER ON PCB):
Always pull off the blue plastic jumper on the relay board! Connect JD-VCC to 5V, and VCC to 3.3V. This isolates relay noise with ZERO extra components.
